When Is The Best Time To Open My Pool?

The best time to open your pool is when night time temperatures start to consistently exceed 5-10 degrees Celsius. The longer you wait to open your pool with warm temperatures the more likely you are to open your pool to an algae bloom.

Opening when temperatures are still a bit cooler is a good idea and gives you a chance to get your pool clean, tidy and ready for the pool season. If you need us for a pool opening you can book right here on this page.
Do you vacuum the pool during a pool opening?

Vacuuming is not included in our standard pool opening but this is something we can do for you. Simply select the option for us to vacuum your pool when booking online or let us know you'd like to have us vacuum your pool when you call and book your pool opening. Vacuuming has an additional charge based on an hourly rate.
After You Open My Pool What Will Be Left For Me To Do?

After we have opened your pool you'll need to do the following.

  1. Vacuum & Brush Your Pool To Get It Clean
  2. Re-test & Balance Water Chemistry Daily Until The Test Results Are Flawless
  3. Store Away Your Winter Pool Cover Once It's Dried
When Should I Clean My Pool Filter After Opening?

Once your pool has reached a clean state after opening is a good time to clean your cartridge filter. 

If you have a sand filter it should be backwashed regularly when the filter pressure rises by 10 psi over the normal operating pressure.
How Often Should I Test My Pool Water? Test your pool water 2-3 times a week, and after heavy use or rain. This ensures proper chemical balance for safe and enjoyable swimming and protects your pool and pool equipment from damage.
